@0xPolygon  Breakdown

 What is Happening in 2025 👇👇

1. POL token replaces MATIC

🔸 As of Q4 2024 Polygon made a major transition 
from MATIC to POL as the native token for gas and staking
Over 88% of holders migrated by year end

🔸This consolidation simplifies UX and improves network efficiency

2. Polygon 2.0 & AggLayer scaling

🔸 The upcoming Polygon 2.0 roadmap focuses on 
AggLayer  a protocol for cross chain ZK aggregation 
and trustless communication across Layer 2

🔸Mid 2025 saw launch of Aggregate Layer v0.2
 testnet showing strong developer support

3. Major enterprise partnerships

🔸Polygon inked agreements with big brands like 
Starbucks, Reddit, Meta (Facebook), Nike, Disney 
Metaverse along with cloud integrations

🔸These enterprise tie ups are building confidence in
 Polygon as a scalable blockchain for real world use

4. Adoption & metrics

🔸Daily addresses recently climbed to 5.6 million 
(~16% rise since April) stablecoin supply now $2.1B

🔸NFT volume exceeded Ethereum weekly trading hit
 $24M via platforms like Courtyard

5. Network pain points

🔸A Heimdall V2 consensus bug triggered 1 hour 
downtime of consensus layer though Bor (block 
production) remained unaffected sync issues followed
 across some RPC providers

🔸Meanwhile the Philippines adopted Polygon chains to notarize government budget documents onchain

6. Governance & leadership shakeup

🔸 @sandeepnailwal co founder became CEO of Polygon Foundation in June 11 2025
 He is streamlining the roadmap doubling down on PoS + AggLayer deprioritizing zkEVM experimental layers

7. Enterprise tokenization & finance

🔸In July 2025 Spain first fully regulated euro 
denominated onchain security token offering (STO) 
BeToken went live on Polygon using ERC 3643 
standard

🔸$1 billion+ in payments have flowed through Polygon early 2025 full scale tokenization for regulated capital markets is accelerating

🧠 TL : DR

🔸Token + Architecture Shift   MATIC POL roll out of 
Polygon 2.0 & AggLayerEnterprise 

🔸Momentum Partnerships with Nike, Starbucks, Google, Disney and more 

🔸Usage Surge Millions of addresses NFTs overtaking Ethereum stablecoin growth

🔸Governance Reset  Sandeep Nailwal takes over roadmap gets ruthless focus
